notes.title: Halloween 2024 Update - Co-op Horror Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43524974/baeb0696424604ddcc8aafe40570a3caa84a8787.jpg[/img]
Update
☠️😨Xongo's Revenge!
New Battle Pass with Horror Mode Included!
Updated Ruby Mine
Halloween Exclusive Cosmetics
=========================
About
Live in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle with all your Monkey friends! Swing on vines, throw doo at your enemies, and climb everything!
Huge Maps: Explore the Bermuda Jungle, Floating Forests, Ancient Ruins, Lava Chasm, and more
Unique Gamemodes: Be the first to collect 10 bananas or work together to fend off hordes of crocs -- new modes are coming all the time
Monkey Apparel: Customize your body color, equip face & head cosmetics, and stylize your doo
Ruby Mines: Explore a seemingly endless set of tunnels filled with lore, new NPC's, and our Battle Pass! Unlock exclusive rewards like Cosmetics, Doos, Boosters, and more with free and paid rewards!
Themed Cosmetics & Hands-on Fun: Get your hands on... well, new Hand cosmetics! Plus, a bunch of wacky, interactive items like things you can eat, press, and shake to your heart's content.
Hidden Treasures: Dive into a revamped store experience and hunt for secrets - like a mysterious portal leading to a hidden market. Plus, uncover new secrets via the plane!

Deep within long abandoned tunnels of the ruby mines a howling rings out -- you decide to dig a little further than you should have...
Jump into the recently installed mining elevator to descend deep into the old ruby mines. Survive the wrath of Xongo & save the Lost Souls in Monkey Doo's all new Horror Mode!

notes.title: V2.12.3 Back to School Minor Update

Minor update 2.12.3 is out now!

New stuff:
The battlepass is now populated with cosmetics designed by the community!
The winners from the last competition are also now available for individual purchase on the sweet deals island

New cosmetics are now in the paint shop rotation

Fixes:
King of the Hill mode now grants the correct amount of banana (sorry 😬 )

Known Issues:
We tried to take the hotdog away from Xongo, but he wouldn't let go of it.

This was the smallest battlepass update so far, but that's because we are hard at work on some CRAZY new stuff coming in the fall, so be sure to stick around!

notes.title: Freeplay Mode V2.11.2 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43524974/8894f01513726edea57de9b71758cf028baf1b0a.png[/img]

2.11.2 is out now!

We added free play mode! You can't use it in the normal multiplayer balloon, it has its own lobby!
You can play in any level without any time limits or game modes.

In freeplay, you are free to join mid-game, swap scenes, or even use any equipment you earned from the battlepass!

There's also a new Freeplay-exclusive "Doolympic Park" map, with 5 different obstacle courses, with leaderboards for whoever completes them the fastest!

Have fun!

notes.title: Summer Update V2.10.0!
notes.content:
We just launched the Summer Update! (2.10.0)

In it you will find a brand new battlepass with brand new summer themed cosmetics.
It also comes with a new equipment: the Deployable Slingshot! Press X to spawn a slingshot, then hop in and crawl away to take aim and launch yourself!

The slingshot deployer can actually be equipped at the same time as either the harpoons or the rockets, btw.

We added a pool area to the crash site, complete with a diving board, waterslides, and a free-to-try slingshot!

There's also a new "cannonball" mechanic: hit the water with enough speed and you'll send anyone nearby flying!

The maze from the ruby mine is now a playable level in versus.

Bug Fixes:
The left grappling hook now works exactly the same way the right one does
You should be able to see other player's equipment even if you join the room later than they did.
You can double jump while moving upward without fear of it eating up your momentum
Drained the water from the ruby mine

Known Issues:
The pool attracted a bunch of plastic flamingos and they're kinda creepy

notes.title: King of the Hill!
notes.content:
2.9.1 is out now!

NEW GAMEMODE: King of the Hill
Fight to stay inside the zone and keep everyone else out! Control the zone for long enough and you win!

NEW STAGES: Tree Trunk, and River
Both support King of the Hill and Banana Chase!

Bug fixes:
Players using the "swap grips and triggers" option are no longer prevented from taking knockback
Knockback is more reliable in general.

notes.title: 2.7.6 hot fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue preventing the game from launching

notes.title: Update 2.7.6
notes.content:
2.7.6 is out now!

New features:

Splatmatch Gamemode! Whoever lands 10 hits first wins! You'll respawn after you get hit, with a few seconds of invulnerability.
The player in the lead will make a little bit of noise wherever they go (no more hiding out in survival mode!)
You can now see when you or another player is invulnerable after being hit or respawning.
Survival can be played in the swamp, again!
Changed the items for sale on the sweet deals island.

Bug fixes:

You can no longer initially spawn on the same platform.

Known issues:

In rare cases you may respawn on the same platform after dying.
Players may occasionally return to the lobby with an invisible head and body. (as soon as they get hit with poop it gets fixed)

Thanks for playing! We're already hard at work on the next update, so stick around!

notes.title: Meta update hotfix
notes.content: This has the updates to match the meta hotfix update. There are known issues with the wrist watch and rocket arms being off from the hand controllers

notes.title: SPACE UPDATE!
notes.content: New maps a rocket wrist booster and more! New may battlepass

notes.title: THE RUBY MINE IS NOW OPEN TO THE PUBLIC!
notes.content:
You'll find a few things inside, including some different caverns to explore, and NPC's to talk to.

Oh, I guess there's also the battlepass tunnel down there!

Throughout the month, as you gain XP, the miners will dig deeper into the tunnel! Check back often to claim your rewards! Some of them are free, but some (including exclusive new cosmetics) require you to use the "Pickaxe of Destiny" for the month in order to clear the stubborn rocks encasing them.

The Pickaxe is avialable for rent, and once purchased will be yours until the end of the month.

And with that out of the way, we have some fixes and additions:

NEW FEATURES
* Turrets were installed at the Tooting range stations
* Disabling PVP now FINALLY prevents you from throwing doodoo in the crash site and lobby. (Don't dish it out if you can't take it!) The toggle was renamed to "Allow Doo Doo"
* Several small improvements to speech bubbles
* Brought back Optico to moderate abusive language
* New Viking bundle available under "Sweet Deelz"
* The launch bundle is now available in the black market.

BUG FIXES
* Usernames in the mute menu should be readable no matter what fur color that player has chosen
* Server connection failures should be much less frequent

Thanks everyone for playing the game, and for all the valuable feedback and bug reports! We've got some really exciting things in the works, stay tuned!

-New interactable cosmetics (edibles, pressables, shakeables, etc)
